Appreciate the fast turnaround, Alex — helpful. Short answers and a suggested pricing sketch below so you can see per-model unit economics at a glance.

Suggested unit economics (example tiers, all $ per 1M tokens equivalent):
- Chat / generation (large context, streaming): $550 / 1M tokens (standard SLA)
- Chat (best-effort latency, lower-cost variant): $320 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (semantic search index updates): $125 / 1M tokens (embeddings billed per 1k vectors normalized to token equivalents in the attached sheet)
- Rerank / scoring API: $200 / 1M tokens (typically lower token volume but higher QPS sensitivity)

Notes:
- These are starting points — we can model blended tiers based on your 65-70 / 25 / 5-10 split to arrive at a blended $/1M and monthly spend.
- Pilot offer: 20% trial discount on first two months of pilot usage (applied to blended spend).
- If you require strict latency (p99 < 150ms) and guaranteed capacity, we’ll need to align on Dedicated capacity pricing (separate line item in SOW).

Action items for BrightLayer: please confirm the approximate steady-state split you expect to use in production (we can run scenarios at 65/25/10 vs 70/20/10). If you have per-feature signal (e.g., embedding update cadence) that changes monthly embedding volume, send that too.

I attached a usage_breakdown_template.csv — if you can populate expected monthly counts by feature (chat sessions, embedding index ops, rerank calls) we’ll return a 3-tier pricing model and cost forecast.

Would you be open to a 20-30 minute follow-up next week to finalize pilot SOW? I’m free Wed/Thu morning PST.

Thanks,
Marissa
